create_Visualizer_instance: create a Visualizer instance to draw detection and segmentation results on images
draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level prediction results with boxes, masks, and labels on an image
draw_sem_seg: draw semantic segmentation predictions with category-colored masks on an image
draw_panoptic_seg: draw panoptic segmentation combining semantic and instance masks with labels
draw_dataset_dict: draw annotations and segmentations from a Detectron2 dataset dictionary on an image
